Priya Ramanathan: hi team! I9m Priya, starting today on Product Analytics (they/she). based in CET, usually online 9-5 CET. quick Qs: who do I ask for SSO/Kerberos SSO access? need read access to analytics db + a service account for a short ETL job. also wondering where onboarding docs for our analytics infra live. fun fact: I keep bees (hobby) and make honey labels. :honey_pot:

Diego (Buddy): welcome Priya!! :tada: I9m Diego, your buddy for the next few weeks. I9ll send a 20-min intro and a repo tour. For docs start with https://intranet.redwood/analytics/onboarding and the notebook atlas in the docs repo.

Sam (IT): hey Priya 50: sent SSO invite & MFA enrollment at 09:15. If you9re blocked, open an IT ticket with subject "SSO Enroll - Priya". For DB access, request role `analytics_read` in the access portal and paste the ticket ID here. For service accounts we require a short justification and TTL; use this form: https://intranet.redwood/access/service-account-request. Example body: `purpose: nightly ETL for cohort report, ttl: 7d`.

Priya Ramanathan: thanks Sam 50 I got the SSO invite. Filing DB access request now; service account form submitted (ticket #A-4621).

Kara H.: hey Priya 50 welcome! If you want to test queries quickly, we have a demo cluster `analytics-play` that you can request temporary creds for. Ping me and I9ll grant it for a day. Also we have a weekly analytics sync on Tuesdays 10am PT.

Bella (People Ops): hi Priya 50 welcome 50 sticker pack & welcome kit tracking shows delivered. If you prefer a 14" linux laptop instead of the default macbook, reply here and I9ll update the order. New-hire orientation calendar invite sent.

Priya Ramanathan: all set 50 accepted invites, confirmed laptop preference to Linux 14". thanks for the quick help! Diego let9s pick a time for the intro tour 50 I9m free after 16:00 CET. Also I can bring some small honey jars to the next in-person meetup :bee: 

Diego (Buddy): great 50 sending a calendar invite for 16:30 CET. can9t wait to see the honey jars :grin:

Sam (IT): noted service-account ticket A-4621, will review and provision short-lived creds once approved.

Priya Ramanathan: perfect, thanks everyone! I9ll lurk in #product-analytics and say hi there. :)
